from pathlib import Path

print('Verified; compressed',len(y),'baseline',len(zlib.compress(x)),'reduction',100*(1-len(y)/len(x)))
c=collections.Counter()
for l in x.splitlines():
 if re.fullmatch(b'[0-9a-f]+',l):c['hex '+str(len(l))]+=1
 elif re.fullmatch(b'[0-9a-z]+',l):c['base36 '+str(len(l))]+=1
 else:c[re.sub(rb'[0-9]+',b'#',l)]+=1
print(c)
